matchmaking_summary: Roxanne Mejia is a highly motivated Chef with extensive experience in managing kitchen staff and ensuring high standards of food quality. Her background includes working as both a Sous Chef and Chef, where she has demonstrated her ability to handle large teams in fast-paced environments while maintaining exceptional customer service. Roxanne's proactive approach to budgeting and cost control ensures the efficient use of resources within the kitchen. She also excels in training and developing new culinary talents, showing great potential for career growth both in this role and at higher levels of management.
